name: Segawa Kyouka
source:
A woman whom [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url] met on his journey of revenge. With her father being European and her mother being Japanese, she has several characteristics of the mixed-race child: flax hair and light reddish-brown eyes.

Not only does Segawa wear unusual Western clothing, but she also appears to be conducting research in folkloristics, a field of study that has only started to rise. Therefore, she leads an outstanding life for a woman of her time.

You can imagine how many challenges Segawa, an intelligent and proper woman, has faced in her life as a result of her origin.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
